description: Standard general-purpose button with icon, tooltip, size, and disabled state support. This is the foundational button component that all other button variants wrap or extend.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Element ID, also used for data-testing-id attribute binding

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the button and shows tooltip if disableTooltipContent is set

inputs.name: disableButton
inputs.description: Alternative disable flag (deprecated — use disabled instead)

inputs.name: disableTooltipContent
inputs.description: Tooltip text shown when button is disabled

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: Font Awesome icon class rendered to the left of buttonText (requires showIcon=true)

inputs.name: iconCap
inputs.description: Font Awesome icon class rendered to the right of buttonText (requires showIcon=true)

inputs.name: showIcon
inputs.description: Enables rendering of icon and iconCap elements

inputs.name: fullWidth
inputs.description: Sets button width to 100% via host class and internal w-full class

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Controls button size via CSS class

inputs.name: uiIconName
inputs.description: SVG icon name for the left icon (signal input, replaces Font Awesome icon)

inputs.name: uiIconCapName
inputs.description: SVG icon name for the right cap icon (signal input)

inputs.name: iconColor
inputs.description: Color for the SVG icon (signal input)

inputs.name: iconSize
inputs.description: Size for the SVG icon (signal input)

outputs.name: action
outputs.description: Emitted on button click when not disabled

outputs.name: deleteAction
outputs.description: Legacy event emitted alongside action (deprecated — use action instead)

expected_internal_elements.description: Wraps the button in a tooltip component for disabled state messaging
Native button element with uui-button class
Optional SVG icon elements (left and/or right cap) when showIcon is true and uiIconName/uiIconCapName are set
Optional Font Awesome icon elements (left and/or right cap) when showIcon is true and icon/iconCap are set

behaviors.description: Component renders and is visible in the DOM
Renders a native button element internally
Displays the buttonText inside the native button
When disabled is true, the native button has the disabled attribute
When disabled, clicking the button does not emit the action event
Clicking the button emits the action event when not disabled
When size is 'large', the button gets the 'large' CSS class
When size is 'small', the button gets the 'small' CSS class
When fullWidth is true, the button gets the 'w-full' class and the host gets 'full-width'
When fullWidth is true, the host element gets the 'full-width' class via HostBinding
The native button type attribute reflects the type input
When showIcon is true and icon has a value, a Font Awesome span is rendered
When showIcon is true and uiIconName is set, a uui-icon element is rendered
When disabled and disableTooltipContent has a value, the tooltip is enabled
The host element has a data-testing-id attribute matching the id input
